Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Build Roll for Veterans 2026 website with interactive map and 82 city pages

## Features Implemented

### Core Website
- Homepage with hero section, countdown timer, and quick action CTAs
- Interactive 3-layer route map \(Overview, Major Stops, All 80+ Cities\)
- 82 pre-generated dynamic city landing pages with SSG
- Team Bravo crew recruitment page with application form
- Professional navigation bar and footer with Team RWB branding

### Technical Implementation
- Next.js 14+ with App Router and TypeScript
- Mapbox GL JS for beautiful, interactive mapping
- Tailwind CSS for responsive utility-first styling
- React Hook Form + Zod for form validation
- Complete data structure with 80+ cities

### Components Created
- RouteMap: Interactive 3-layer navigation map with Mapbox
- MapControls: Toggle between map layers
- HeroSection: Compelling hero with call-to-action
- CountdownTimer: Live countdown to Feb 27, 2026 \(updates every second\)
- QuickActions: Button grid for key user actions
- Navigation: Sticky header with mobile menu
- Footer: Comprehensive footer with Team RWB info and links
- City Pages: Dynamic [city] routes with static generation
- Team Bravo Page: Recruitment with form and role descriptions

### Data & Content
- 80+ cities with coordinates, arrival dates, populations, RWB chapters
- 19 major stops highlighted throughout the journey
- 4,434-mile route from Key West to Grand Canyon
- 108-day journey countdown

### Quality & Performance
- Production-ready build \(25MB\)
- All TypeScript types validated
- Custom 404 and error pages with helpful navigation
- SEO-optimized metadata on all pages
- Mobile-first responsive design
- Zero build warnings or errors

## File Structure
- src/app/: Next.js app router with pages
- src/components/: Reusable React components
- src/data/: Cities data in JSON format
- src/types/: TypeScript interfaces
- src/lib/: Helper functions for data querying
- src/hooks/: Custom React hooks \(useCountdown\)

## Deployment Ready
- Vercel-optimized configuration
- Environment variables configured for Mapbox
- All pages pre-built for instant loading
- Zero-cost hosting via Vercel free tier

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
